notes: The API is an active production product, but the entry uses the wrong documentation URL, omits the published 100-credit trial limit, misstates request limits as unpublished, and supplies an unsupported multipart upload example. Official materials support image-based insect identification and pest-related metadata, but not all asserted IPM and livestock-app usage claims.
